```{r}
# Assuming b = X and c = Y are known values based on the actual data
# Construct the 2x2 contingency table
library(tinytex)
library(readxl)
data3 <- read_excel("q3_data.xlsx")
head(data3)
```

```{r}
# Step 2: Create the 2x2 contingency table
table_data <- table(data3$`Before the debate`, data3$`After the debate`)
print(table_data)
# It should look like:
#       After
# Before    A   B
#      A   xx  yy
#      B   zz  ww
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
library(Hmisc)
latex(describe(data3), file = "", caption.placement = "top")
```

```{r}
# Perform McNemar's test
result <- mcnemar.test(table_data,correct = FALSE)
print(result)

```

從McNemar's Chi-squared test中可以得知其結果不拒絕虛無假設(在debate的前後其人們的想法並無改變)，也就是無統計上顯著的呈現在debate的前後人們有什麼想法上的改變。
